hook.name: TrinityHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for a TRI/ETH pool that charges a flat 3% fee on every swap (split 1% burn, 1% liquidity reinvestment, 1% rewards). In afterSwap it skims the fee from the unspecified currency via the afterSwapReturnsDelta mechanism and routes it into accounting buckets; heavy actions (burns, conversions, liquidity adds) execute separately in keeper-callable transactions.
